PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Operations Manager – Sample Restaurant
- Directed comprehensive daily operations including staff scheduling, inventory coordination, vendor management, customer issue resolution, and operational reporting to maintain seamless service delivery.
- Maintained operational discipline and upheld service standards during peak service periods, effectively leading front-of-house teams and supervisors.
- Coordinated vendor communications and follow-ups to ensure timely supply deliveries, supporting consistent stock availability and uninterrupted restaurant operations.
- Implemented enhanced stock check procedures, increasing inventory accuracy and reducing discrepancies.
- Streamlined shift handover processes to improve communication and operational continuity between teams.

LEADERSHIP EXPERIENCE

- Led and motivated supervisors and front-of-house teams, fostering a collaborative environment focused on service excellence and operational consistency.
- Coordinated cross-functional efforts to uphold customer satisfaction and maintain operational discipline.
- Applied strong organizational and problem-solving skills to resolve customer issues promptly, enhancing guest experience and team responsiveness.

ACHIEVEMENTS

- Sustained stable and efficient operations during high-volume service periods, ensuring consistent customer satisfaction and team performance.
- Optimized inventory control through improved stock check routines, reducing potential stock losses and enhancing accuracy.
- Enhanced operational continuity and communication via refined shift handover processes, contributing to smoother daily transitions.
